name: gregeland-games
description: Geland Games family library and release gateway for games.gregeland.com

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/portal && wrangler deploy --config release/origin-probe/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist/origin-probe
scripts.types: wrangler types && wrangler types release/origin-probe/worker-configuration.d.ts --config release/origin-probe/wrangler.jsonc --env-file release/origin-probe/.dev.vars.example --env-interface OriginProbeEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.types:check: wrangler types --check && wrangler types release/origin-probe/worker-configuration.d.ts --config release/origin-probe/wrangler.jsonc --env-file release/origin-probe/.dev.vars.example --env-interface OriginProbeEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --check
